answer: Sybil resistance works through a stake-weighted cost floor, not identity checks. Every agent seeking voting weight must lock a bond slashed in full if two identities share one operator key. An attacker posts that bond per puppet, so a thousand agents means a thousand times the capital at risk, and one correlated misstep burns all of it. Each extra identity carries a flat, brutal cost. Honest operators exit whole; farmers drain the river of funds and never return. The same toll blocks every path, so the network earns nectar while the adversary meets only a nadir of negative returns.
